name: Hyperping
summary: Hyperping's free plan has 20 monitors at 5-minute checks and one basic status page. Paid plans cost $290 to $2,990 a year for 50 to 1,000 monitors, with checks every 20 or 30 seconds from 18 regions across 7 global zones.

evidence.capability: checks from many locations, with a second check from other regions before alerting

facts.text: Hyperping lists 18 monitoring regions across 7 global zones.
A failed check is immediately double-checked from the other regions selected for that monitor, and only confirmed failures open an outage and trigger alerts.
Hyperping says it does not hold independent SOC 2 or ISO 27001 certifications at this time, and that its infrastructure providers hold their own.
Hyperping says all primary customer data, including databases, application servers and backups, is stored in the European Union, at DigitalOcean's Frankfurt data center.
Account SAML SSO is listed on the Pro and Business plans. Status page SSO for Entra ID, Okta and Google is a $49 a month add-on on Business.

plans.name: Free
plans.notes: 20 monitors at 5-minute checks, 1 basic status page, 1 seat

plans.name: Essentials
plans.notes: Shown as $24 a month when billed yearly. No monthly-billing price is published. 50 monitors at 30-second checks, 3 seats, 20 SMS credits

plans.name: Pro
plans.notes: Shown as $74 a month when billed yearly. No monthly-billing price is published. 250 monitors at 30-second checks, 10 seats, 75 SMS credits, account SAML SSO

plans.name: Business
plans.notes: $299 a month on monthly billing. 1,000 monitors at 20-second checks, 20 seats, 200 SMS credits

hiddenCosts: Extra seats cost $7 a month on Essentials, $9 on Pro and $12 on Business.
Status page SSO is a $49 a month add-on per connection for Entra ID, Okta and Google, and $99 a month for other providers, on Business.
